reply: {"action":"run_code","code":"const repo = 'acme/web'; const counts = new Map<string, Set<number>>(); const issues = []; for (let page = 1; ; page++) { const result = await tools.list_issues({repo, state:'open', label:'perf', page}) as any; const rows = result.items; issues.push(...rows); if (rows.length < 50) break; } const withComments = issues.filter(issue => issue.comments > 0); for(let start=0; start<withComments.length; start+=12) { await Promise.all(withComments.slice(start,start+12).map(async issue => { for(let page=1; ;page++) { const result = await tools.list_comments({repo, number:issue.number, page}) as any; const rows = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.items; for (const comment of rows) { const login = comment.user.login; if (!counts.has(login)) counts.set(login, new Set()); counts.get(login)!.add(issue.number); } if(rows.length < 50) break; } })); } return [...counts].filter(([, numbers]) => numbers.size >= 4).map(([login]) => login).sort();","answer":""}
